answer_1.quote: We propose the dataset ParaTrex which is constructed using the large language model GPT-3.5... We generate 40 paraphrases for each relation, including short and long paraphrases.
answer_1.outputs: Paraphrased prompt templates for factual knowledge probing.

answer_2.quote: We test the lexical diversity by reporting the average pairwise BLEU scores... We perform the current SoTA version paraphrase‑multilingual‑mpnet‑base‑v2 of Sentence‑BERT ... to evaluate the semantic similarity between the paraphrase and the grounding prompt template.

answer_4.quote: We perform human evaluation by asking the evaluators to select candidates that are not the paraphrase of the given inputs... Results show that on average among 11 human judgments, human evaluators get 96.88% accuracy in successfully identifying inaccurate paraphrases.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators were instructed to identify which candidates are not correct paraphrases of the given input prompts.
